text: Your ask function queries a language model, which is flakier and costlier than your average API. What if Zubenelgenubi implodes? Promise.all will reject immediately, while tree and beetle keep churning, draining your already parched coffers for nothing. Promise-strewn code is prone to leakage. Once created, promises run to completion, whether or not they're still required.
